headline: PL Capital releases its top ten stock picks for Diwali 2026

headline: Transformers and Rectifiers shares jump 7% on Rs 1,250-crore investment plan
hook: Capacity expansion drives stock price rally
summary: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Ltd shares rose 7.29% to Rs 321.50 following the announcement of a Rs 1,250-crore investment plan. The company's market capitalization increased to Rs 9,579.79 crore as a result of the positive market reaction. This capital expenditure is intended to scale up operations and manufacturing capabilities.
why_it_matters: Increased manufacturing capacity may boost long-term revenue growth for shareholders.
